text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In case of overdose, standard supportive measures should be instituted as required. Varenicline has been shown to be dialyzed in patients with end-stage renal disease [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ], however, there is no experience in dialysis following overdose.
